title: Beacon Security, which offers an agentic security platform, raised a $13M seed and says it has "tens" of large enterprise customers including Cerebras (Chris Metinko/Axios)
summary: Chris Metinko / Axios: Beacon Security, which offers an agentic security platform, raised a $13M seed and says it has “tens” of large enterprise customers including Cerebras — Beacon Security, an agentic security platform, raised a $13 million seed led by Notable Capital, CEO Gal Tal-Hochberg tells Axios Pro exclusively.
